notes.title: JetBall Arena V1.1 extra features added - April 16th 2019
notes.content:
[h1]Extra features released April 16th 2019 :-[/h1]

[h1]Practice Mode[/h1]
Master the game mechanics of each arena, without having to test yourself against your rivals. Practice movement, ball control and different methods of scoring.

[h1]New arena - Mars[/h1]
This arena introduces moving goals.
There's an extra level of difficulty involved as goals move around the arena using their thrusters.
